bounded_conclusion: The original 0.03--0.01 squared-GN output finite-difference range was too coarse for this frozen cell. Four consecutive smaller binary scales match the executed-graph autograd tangent and action within the preregistered five-percent tolerance.
claim_ceiling: One checkpoint state, one frozen batch, one direction, one arm, and the squared-GN harness only. This is measurement calibration, not evidence about FID, training quality, population behavior, global differentiability, or a schedule mechanism.
